doc.title: Jack DeJohnette interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 7, 2025

title: Staying calm and playing weekly in retirement
summary: He says he chose high-level situations and now plays weekly with musicians for fun.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: I just was looking at the CD Guide to Jazz and they mention both those recordings of yours as whatever critic was writing was very positive about those. A couple of more things before we wrap up, you seem like a patient and thoughtful and calm individual. I wonder if there’s things musically in situations that could aggravate you?

I was fortunate enough to take situations where that didn’t happen you know. I was always in a situation where I felt that I was at the highest level of creativity and quality so I was fortunate enough to be in those kind of situations. I’d put myself in those situations.
So now I have musical situations now that I’m retired that — where I get together with a group of musicians once a week and we just play for the fun of it. That’s great.
